change: The launch review period ended, so ballots that pass screening now open without owner approval. Flagged items still wait for review.
Players are now credited and ranked by their username, in place of an optional public name.
Ballots were replaced by a public idea board. The top upvoted idea is built each round, and "change nothing this round" is always an option.
Ideas are now rated small, medium, or major, and bigger changes need more upvotes.
Medium and major changes now start at one upvote. Their targets grow with the number of active players: a quarter of them for medium, half for major.
Major changes now need a third of active players instead of half, and a player counts as active for three days.
Players can now downvote ideas. An idea is removed once downvotes outnumber upvotes and reach a third of active players. Player suggestions also leave the board after three days without an upvote.
The game can now keep a small save on a logged-in player's account, so progress can follow them between devices.
If players vote for it, the game can now show other logged-in players, marks they left, and shared progress. Others appear without names, and players can't send each other words.
